what: When the pointer is over the pill button, letters one by one (.05s apart) tilt randomly between −15 and 15°, grow 1.15~1.4x and thicken to weight 600 (.25s power2.out), then spring back upright to their normal weight in the same order with elastic.out(1, .8) over .25s. It restarts from the beginning on every hover. On phones, it plays on press

options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to split (if empty, the whole element’s text)
options.amount: Total time (sec) shared across all characters instead of a per-character gap — .25 for long-label buttons
options.weight: Weight when popping, default 600 — without a variable font, weight steps change abruptly
options.ease · back: Bounce curve · return curve, defaults power2.out · elastic.out(1, 0.8)
